rows.title_full: AN ACT MODERNIZING THE PHILIPPINE POSTAL CORPORATION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Aims to enable PhilPost to be a competitive provider of mail delivery services with an extensive coverage across the country.
Proposes the following:  Phil Post shall serve as the primary delivery service provider of government offices and agencies. 

Ensures security of data and communication in a manner that is consistent with the Data Privacy Act of 2012; Seeks to adopt technology-driven business solutions and offer on-demand courier services with real-time tracking features.

rows.title_full:
AN ACT AFFORDING MORE PROTECTION TO CONSUMERS OF FINANCIAL PRODUCTS AND
SERVICES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address increasing consumer fraud, abuse and misconduct brought about by rapid development of complex financial products coupled with advanced technologies.

Proposes to establish comprehensive financial consumer protection involving financial inclusion, financial education, good governance, and effective supervision.  

Provides for, among others, financial regulators such as Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, Insurance Commission and Securities and Exchange Commission, rulemaking, surveillance and inspection, market monitoring, enforcement and adjudication powers relative to consumer protection.

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE CYBERCRIME PREVENTION MEASURES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10175, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "CYBERCRIME PREVENTION ACT OF 2012"
rows.abstract:
Proposes to widen the scope of computer-data related offenses and allow for the prosecution of more key players involved in the commission and proliferation of cybercrime offenses, such as principals by inducement.
Provides that any party who suffers damages caused by the commission of the offense, either directly or indirectly, may initiate the prosecution of the offender.
Seeks to amend R.A. NO.10175 regarding the following: 
Definitions of service provider, subscriber´s information, and identifying information; Descriptions of cybercrime offenses; and other offenses regarding the aiding or abetting in the commission of cybercrime.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATIONS TECHNOLOGY since 2023-09-21

rows.author: K131;
rows.title_full: AN ACT SETTING THE CEILING INTEREST RATES ON LOANS, FORBEARANCE OF MONEY, GOODS OR CREDIT, OR ANY MONETARY OBLIGATIONS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the influx of loan applications to private and public lending institutions where these entities imposed unconscionable interest rates and penalty fees or unjust terms and conditions and abusive lending practices.

Prescribes (12%) maximum on stipulated interest rate per annum, including commissions, and premiums, on secured loan or forbearance of any money, goods, or credits - while there shall be a ceiling rate of (24%) for interest rates expressly provided for unsecured loans or forbearances . 

Includes as “juridical persons” the following, but not limited to:  lending company (RA 9474), financing company (RA 8556), banks (RA 8791), credit card companies, pawnshops, investment houses, savings and loan associations, mortgage companies, insurance companies, cooperatives, operators of Online Lending Platforms (OLPs) as defined under SEC Memo Circular No.10, series of 2021, and other related institutions already regulated by law.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2023-09-21

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MAGNA CARTA OF YOUNG FARMERS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address future critical shortage of farmers and the employment drop in agricultural sector - through increasing agricultural production and farming subsidies and incentivizing members particularly the youth.

Aims to promote and fulfill the rights of young farmers in all aspects but not limited to their rights to food security, education, training and access to land; Establishes the National Young Farmers and Fisherfolks Council.

Defines several terms among others, such as Agriculture, Eco-warriors, Food Security, and Organic Agriculture and others.

Provides for the following provisions regarding the following:  State as primary duty bearer; Non-Diminution of the Rights of Young Farmers; Linkage with SUC of choice; Access to Technology, Credit and Capital; Right to Resources for Food Production (land transfer tax exemptions; land and farm planning management); Nat´l Young Farmers Roadmap; Recognition and preservation of Cultural Identity and Indigenous Farming Traditions; strengthen Young Farmer Organizations; Legal Protection on Negotiations and Trade Partnership Agreements; Farm Insurance and others, etc.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10840

rows.title_short: Instituting Reforms To Enhance The Efficiency And Dynamism Of The Philippine Capital Markets, Amending For The Purpose Sections 22, 24, 25, 121, 127, And 190 Of Republic Act No. 8424, Otherwise Known As The National Internal Revenue Code Of 1997, As Amended
rows.abstract: Aims to boost the capital markets and the investment competitiveness of the Philippines, and create equality in the tax treatment of debt and stock securities by instituting the following: 1.) Reduction of the stock transaction tax from 0.6% to 0.1%; 2.) Reduction of the dividends tax to non-resident aliens from 25% to 10% to harmonize the cash and property dividends rate; 3.) Reduces the tax on Philippine Charity Sweepstakes and lotto winnings from 20% to 10%; and 4.) Reduces the documentary stamp tax on horse race ticket or PCSO lottery ticket from 20 % to 10%

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE ONLINE PLACING OF BETS FOR ALL LOTTO GAMES
rows.title_short: Prohibiting The Online Placing Of Bets For All Lotto Games
rows.abstract:
Mandates that bets for all Lotto games shall only be done physically and only in authorized Lotto Outlets.
Prohibits the online placing of bets thru mobile phones, laptops, tablets, personal computers and other similar gadgets for all Lotto games.
Provides that any change in the system and procedures to play all Lotto games which have impact on revenue generation, livelihood of the lotto agents, and the charity mandate of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office shall be made public to the affected stakeholders and subject to the approval of the Office of the President.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING LARGE-SCALE AGRI-FISHERY COMMODITIES, AND TOBACCO SMUGGLING, HOARDING, PROFITEERING, CARTELIZING, AND OTHER ACTS OF MARKET ABUSE AS ECONOMIC SABOTAGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10845, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ANTI-AGRICULTURAL SMUGGLING ACT OF 2016
rows.abstract:
Seeks to promote the productivity of the agriculture, fishery, and tobacco sectors to protect the Filipino farmers and fisherfolks from unscrupulous traders and importers, promote the affordability and stability of supply of food, agri-fishery commodities, and tobacco by preventing large-scale smuggling, hoarding, profiteering, cartelizing, and other acts of market abuse that manipulate prices and unduly restrain supply.  
Aims to impose higher penalties for large-scale smuggling, hoarding, profiteering, cartelizing, and other acts of market abuse of agri-fishery commodities or tobacco, and to public officials or employees who take part in, tolerate, or consent to the doing of the same, as a self-preservation measure to shield itself from the manipulative scheme of economic saboteurs, and to protect the livelihood of our farmers and fisherfolk to ensure their economic well-being and that of the consumers.
Establishes the Anti Agri-Fishery Commodities and Tobacco Economic Sabotage Council which shall be under the Office of the President, with the President or his duly appointed permanent representative as the Chairperson.

rows.abstract:
Seeks to create a standing Committee on Climate Change in every LGU that will address their specific environmental concerns  to lead to effective adaptation solutions tailored to a specific location.
Provides that all matters relating to strategies, technologies, and innovation addressing climate change causes and impacts, including but not limited to avoidance and reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, climate risk management to enhance adaptive capacity and reduce vulnerability to climate risks, all matters relating to adaptation and mitigation, to enhance resilience, promotion of sustainable development including disciplines like disaster management/mitigation/risk reduction and preparedness, shall be within the scope of the Committee.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE ATOMIC ENERGY REGULATORY AUTHORITY AND PROVIDING FOR A COMPREHENSIVE LEGAL FRAMEWORK FOR NUCLEAR SAFETY, SECURITY, AND SAFEGUARDS IN THE PEACEFUL UTILIZATION OF NUCLEAR ENERGY IN THE PHILIPPINES, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Philippine National Nuclear Energy Safety Act
rows.abstract: Aims to harness the peaceful, safe, and secure use of atomic energy that will provide benefits to the Philippines in the fields of energy production, health and medicine, scientific research, agriculture, industry, education, and others; and prohibit the use of nuclear energy for non-peaceful uses. Establishes the Philippine Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority otherwise known as the PhilATOM which shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to exercise regulatory control for the peaceful, safe, and secure uses of nuclear energy and radiation sources of the country; provides for a comprehensive technical and legal safety framework for the utilization and application of Nuclear Energy in the Philippines; and enable the Philippines to meet its international obligations on the use of nuclear energy.
rows.status: Transmitted to the President on 2025-08-19

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING THE RIGHTS OF ALL WORKERS, WORKERS´ ORGANIZATIONS, AND UNIONS FROM INTERFERENCE BY THEIR EMPLOYERS, PUBLIC AUTHORITIES OR THEIR AGENTS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.title_short: Strengthening The Freedom Of Association Of Workers´ Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to protect and uphold the rights of all workers and promote their welfare, and to give full protection to labor, local and overseas, organized and unorganized. 
Prohibits any person to restrain, harass or coerce or unduly interfere with any private worker or workers´ association trade union center, federation, union, or labor or employees´ organization in the exercise of their rights to self-organization, or shall in any manner, commit any act in violation of the provisions of this Act.
Prohibits any members of the AFP, CAFGU, PNP, NTF-ELCAC and other military and police forces to vilify, label, brand, red-tag, name or accuse workers´ organization or unions, labor leaders, members or organizers as subversives or terrorists or to harass or forcibly interrogate workers or union officials based on mere membership or affiliation to labor organization or unions. 
Provides penalties for the violation of this Act.
